abstract: Design-system reference extracted (via live getComputedStyle) from APIMart (aiuxu.com) logged-in dashboard. Captures the shadcn/ui 'new-york' minimal aesthetic: Geist typography, neutral grayscale palette with a single deep-green primary (#216d51), flat borderless-shadow cards on a #fafafa canvas, 10px radius, and compact controls. Includes full theme tokens, component recipes (page shell, cards, buttons, badges, flat data tables, pagination, filters), and mapping guidance to the new-api web/classic console (.app-console scope).
